verdict.rationale: Pulumi exposes Automation API (full programmatic IaC control equivalent to CLI) and a Cloud REST API for calling from the CLI, plus Automation API described as exposing 'the full power of infrastructure as code' programmatically. However, the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec, and evidence doesn't confirm that all Pulumi Cloud UI features (e.g., team/org management, policy management dashboards, Neo delegation) are fully API-accessible versus CLI/UI-only. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/full REST API reference confirming UI-parity, independent/hands-on confirmation that Cloud UI features (policy, org admin, Neo) are all reachable via API, and evidence of parity for non-Automation-API workflows.
